source_metadata.citation: Bolton, T. A.; Reineccius, G. A.; Liardon, R.; Huynh-Ba, T. Role of Cysteine in the Formation of 2-Methyl-3-furanthiol in a Thiamine-Cysteine Model System. ACS Symp. Ser. 1994, 543 (Thermally Generated Flavors), 270-278.
source_metadata.verification_method: Full text read (ACS Symposium Series 543, ch. 22, pp. 270-278; PDF supplied by the owner 2026-09-04 as data/articles/bolton1993.pdf).
source_metadata.replaces: thiamine_cys_ribose_100C_Hofmann1996 (deleted 2026-08-26; its DOI 10.1021/jf960062o was never registered with any DOI agency and its reported MFT value 3.14 ppb is numerically pi)
source_metadata.measurement_basis: Table II: ng MFT per 33.3 g of thermally processed sample (footnote b); systems I / II / IV = 389 +/- 57, 489 +/- 90, 425 +/- 103; the abstract states the same range as ng/33.3 g. Target = system I, 11.7 ppb.
source_metadata.ph_note: pH 5.5-5.8 before and after processing (Process section); 5.65 used. Not buffered.
source_metadata.concentration_note: Table I solids composition (g/100 g): MSG 45.19, NaCl 45.19, IMP 5.73, D-glucose 2.16, thiamine-HCl 1.08, cysteine-HCl 0.43 (system I; 34S-cysteine-HCl 0.43 in II-IV; D-xylose 0.22 in III-IV). 10 g solids + 23.3 g water per vial. Molarities here are per litre of ADDED water (the aqueous phase before dissolution of the salts): glucose 51.5 mM, thiamine-HCl 13.7 mM, cysteine-HCl 11.7 mM. MSG, NaCl and IMP are omitted because they are not reactive precursors on this path; the very high ionic strength is a declared difference from the dilute model systems the sulfur lane was fitted on.
source_metadata.independent_corroboration: 11.7-14.7 ppb sits inside Kerscher & Grosch (10.1021/jf970892v) 5-28 ug/kg MFT for real boiled meat.
source_metadata.sulfur_origin_note: Only 7.5-8.0 percent of MFT sulfur came from 34S-labelled cysteine, i.e. thiamine is the dominant sulfur source in this system; no thiamine gave no MFT.
source_metadata.water_activity_note: a_w 0.83 at ambient temperature before processing (Process section); the core has no a_w term.

metadata.notes: Quantitative Family 03 thiamine-fragmentation anchor: thiamine-HCl + cysteine-HCl + D-glucose (+ MSG, NaCl, IMP) at 30 % solids, sealed vials, 120 C for 60 min, MFT by dichloromethane extraction and GC/MS-SIM against a dodecane internal standard. REBUILT 2026-09-04 FROM THE FULL TEXT (data/articles/bolton1993.pdf): composition from Table I, pH 5.5-5.8 and a_w 0.83 from the Process section, MFT from Table II (system I). Until this date pH, molarities and the value were taken from the indexed abstract with assumed loadings. THE FINDING THIS BENCHMARK CARRIES: no MFT formed without thiamine (system III) and only 7.5-8 % of the MFT carried cysteine's 34S, so the MFT here is thiamine-derived; the sugar/cysteine route contributes nothing measurable at these conditions.

validation_contract.tolerance_rationale: The published spread across the four model variants is only +/- 13 percent, but the unpinned pH, the assumed molarities and the abstract-only sourcing each move MFT by roughly 2-3x. A factor-of-3 band (about 4-40 ppb) is the tightest contract this source supports; a factor-of-2 band would over-claim.

2-Methyl-3-furanthiol (MFT).value_provenance: Table II, model system I (unlabelled cysteine, no xylose): 389 +/- 57 ng MFT per 33.3 g of thermally processed sample = 11.7 ppb (w/w), 1 SD = 15 %. Systems II (34S-cysteine) 489 +/- 90 and IV (with xylose) 425 +/- 103 ng/33.3 g; system III (no thiamine) not detected (limit ca. 10 ng).

content_verification.quoted_quantification: Samples were extracted (5 x 20 mL) with dichloromethane ... Dodecane was added as an internal standard at 1 ppm to the 100 mL-solvent extract ... concentrated under N2 gas to 0.10 mL. ... An internal standard method was used to quantify MFT. The relative response factor of MFT/C12 was calculated from the area sum of three integrated ions from the SIM data of calibration solutions of dodecane (m/z 58, 85, 170) and MFT (m/z 71, 113, 114).
